name: Biribiri Panic Buru x Karu
original_name: ビリビリパニック ぶる×かる
source:
4 school girls were annoyed with upcoming student report, end of semester exam, and marathon competition.
Then, Daisuke offers to give them a reward if they try their best on those.
Haruka and Natsumi got excited imagining they can make out with Daisuke.
Here comes harem play, four girls in gym uniform surrounds Daisuke.

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE046594.html]English DLSite[/url]]
translation:
4名女学生对即将到来的学生报告、期末考试和马拉松比赛感到恼火。
然后，大辅提出，如果他们尽力而为，就会给他们奖励。
遥和夏美很兴奋地想象着他们可以和大辅亲热。
后宫游戏来了，四个穿着体操服的女孩围着大辅。
